docs.query: Can I use the fingerprint sensor on my phone underwater?
docs.text:
Fingerprint recognition underwater

Galaxy phones do not support fingerprint recognition underwater. This is a limitation of the sensor hardware and it cannot be changed in Settings.

docs.query: Why does my screen show a notch?
docs.text:
About the front camera cutout

The front camera is placed in a small cutout at the top of the screen. The cutout is part of the phone design and is not a fault.
